extraction.Name: Mary White Russell
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her 480 acre allotment at the time it was issued, account of not wishing to pay taxes, and she was not a citizen at the time; but this paper was sent to her by John Clifford, from the Indian Agency, forcing her to accept citizenship and the forced patent to her land
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Peter Duhamel, of Rapid City, South Dakota, for $600.00; sold to an unnamed man for $1700.00, the man buying the place paying off the mortgage, which left her $1000.00 cash
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: got behind in taxes; that she mortgaged the three quarters to Peter Duhamel, of Rapid City, South Dakota, for $600.00; that she could not pay off this mortgage, so she sold it
extraction.Occupation/Income: receiving a ration recommended by the Government Doctor
extraction.NOTES: mentally incompetent, has poor health, having rheumatism especially; husband is dead; has no one to help her; lately the Government Doctor recommended a ration for her which she is now receiving; outside of this ration she has never gotten any help from the County, State nor the United States Government; allotment described as three quarters (480 acres); document signed with a mark (X) | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
